chunks: From him, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Rifāʿah, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who forgot to bow until he prostrated and stood up. He said: He restarts.

key_terms.يَرْكَعَ: to perform rukūʿ, the bowing posture in salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَسْتَقْبِلُ: he restarts or begins the prayer anew
key_terms.يَسْجُدَ: to perform sajdah, the prostration in salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَقُومَ: to stand up after the omitted act

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets rukūʿ in salat (prayer) until after sajdah and standing up?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the rukūʿ in salat (prayer) until after sajdah and standing up. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that he must begin the prayer anew, indicating the central importance of rukūʿ in the validity of salat.
